card.name: Verbs right after "if" conditions
card.fires_on: The word right after an "if" or "when" clause subject in label instructions, usually will, is, would, use or this. It marks where the condition's verb is about to be completed.

modes.label: Verb after if-subject
modes.description: A helper verb such as will, is or would follows "if it" or a similar subject in a conditional instruction.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a conditional clause, and away from words about benefit or effect.
